contract: Road user a is behind road user b at an observation: their headings are aligned and b's body lies wholly ahead of a's along a's heading. Measured as headings aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance, the cosine of the largest angle between the headings counted as aligned), the bearing of b from a (rel.bearing) pointing forward in a's frame, and the two footprints' projections on a's heading sharing no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap below zero). Either road user may be at rest. Not a stand-in for following in the same lane: b may travel in another lane.

params.name: alignment
params.meaning: the cosine of the largest angle between the two headings counted as aligned

elements.span: headings aligned (rel.same_direction with the alignment tolerance, the cosine of the largest angle between the headings counted as aligned)
elements.justification: rel.same_direction: 'headings aligned: the cosine of the angle between the headings is above its tolerance'.

elements.span: the bearing of b from a (rel.bearing) pointing forward in a's frame
elements.justification: rel.bearing: 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for ... "immediately to the rear")'; a forward component tells ahead from behind, which the overlap alone does not.

elements.span: the two footprints' projections on a's heading sharing no length (rel.longitudinal_overlap below zero)
elements.justification: rel.longitudinal_overlap: 'the length the two footprints' projections on that axis share, negative for the gap between the projections'; it is a projection, so it is used for 'wholly ahead' and never as a distance or a contact. rel.ahead_behind_in_lane is not read, since it holds only within one lane.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: a travels in the left lane with a gap between its front and the rear of b, which is at rest in the right lane, headings aligned.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: a is alongside b: their projections on a's heading share a length.
